units.source_text: 将近山庄，望见那篱垣外面警卫森严，气象与往日大异。

en.t: As they neared the mountain villa, they saw that the guards outside the fence were extremely strict, and the whole atmosphere was very different from before.

units.source_text: 便有人连声盘问：“来者是谁？”

en.t: At once someone repeatedly questioned them, asking, "Who goes there?"

units.source_text: 匂亲王连忙退回，派一个熟悉当地情况的仆人前往，连这仆人也受盘问。

en.t: Prince Niou hurriedly withdrew and sent forward a servant who knew the place well, but even that servant was questioned.

units.source_text: 可见情形与从前不同了。

en.t: It was clear that things were no longer as they had been before.

units.source_text: 仆人不胜狼狈，连忙答道：“京中有要函派我送来。”

en.t: The servant was terribly flustered and quickly answered, "I have been sent from the capital to deliver an urgent letter."

units.source_text: 便指出右近的一个女仆的名字，叫她出来相见，把情形告诉了她。

en.t: He then gave the name of one of Ukon's maids, had her called out to meet him, and told her what had happened.

units.source_text: 女仆进去告知右近，右近非常狼狈，叫她出去回复：“今夜无论如何也不行，实在对不起得很！”

en.t: The maid went in and told Ukon, who was greatly distressed and sent her back out with the reply, "Tonight is impossible no matter what. I am truly very sorry."

units.source_text: 仆人回去将此言报告了匂亲王。

en.t: The servant returned and reported this message to Prince Niou.

units.source_text: 匂亲王想道：“为什么忽然这样疏远我了？”

en.t: Prince Niou thought, "Why has she suddenly become so distant from me?"

units.source_text: 他不能忍受，对时方说：“还是你进去找侍从吧。

en.t: Unable to bear it, he said to Tokikata, "You should go in and find Jijuu after all.

units.source_text: 总得替我想个好办法。”

en.t: You must think of some good way to help me."

units.source_text: 便派他前往。

en.t: So he sent him ahead.

units.source_text: 时方是个机灵人，信口开河地搪塞了一会，果然被他进去找到了侍从。

en.t: Tokikata was quick-witted, and after talking his way through for a while with whatever came to mind, he did manage to get inside and find Jijuu.

units.source_text: 侍从说：“听说，不知为了什么，薰大将发下紧急命令。

en.t: Jijuu said, "I hear that, for some unknown reason, General Kaoru has issued urgent orders.

units.source_text: 因此最近守夜人警备森严，实在毫无办法了。

en.t: Because of that, the night guards have recently been watching very strictly, and there is truly nothing we can do.

units.source_text: 我家小姐也为此十分忧虑。

en.t: Our young lady is also deeply worried about this.

units.source_text: 她深恐屈辱了亲王，非常担心。

en.t: She is very afraid of bringing shame upon the prince, and is terribly anxious.

units.source_text: 尤可虑者：今夜亲王如果被守夜人看到了，以后事情就更加难办。

en.t: What worries us most is that if the prince is seen by the night guards tonight, matters will become even harder afterward.

units.source_text: 等不久以后亲王决定了来迎的日子，到那天晚上我们这里就悄悄地先做准备，通知你们来迎吧。”

en.t: When the prince soon decides on the day to come for her, we will quietly make preparations here that night and let you know to come and escort her away."

units.source_text: 又告诉他这里的乳母晚上容易觉醒，叫他小心。

en.t: She also told him that the nurse here was easily awakened at night, and warned him to be careful.

units.source_text: 时方答道：“亲王来此，一路上是很不容易的。

en.t: Tokikata replied, "It was far from easy for the prince to come all the way here.

units.source_text: 看他的样子定要会见小姐呢。

en.t: Judging from his manner, he is determined to see the young lady.

units.source_text: 我倘回报他办不成功，他将责我怠慢。

en.t: If I report back that I could not arrange it, he will blame me for negligence.

units.source_text: 还请你和我同去，我们一同把情形向他详细说明吧。”

en.t: Please come with me, and together we can explain the situation to him in detail."

units.source_text: 便催侍从同走。

en.t: With that, he urged Jijuu to go with him.

units.source_text: 侍从说：“这太没道理了！”

en.t: Jijuu said, "That is completely unreasonable!"

units.source_text: 两人争执期间，夜色已经很深。

en.t: While the two argued, the night had already grown very late.
